transcript: I just wanted to say thank you on behalf of everyone. I'm sure they all can agree with me. Thank you for being such a lovely human. Thank you for being such a good friend. You show up and support people whenever they need it the most. Thank you for loving unconditionally and without expectations. You just love and that's why you're so surrounded by love. Because the love you give multiplies back to you. You have this superpower of making everyone feel so seen, loved, understood, heard. So please never stop being you. And thank you. Thank you for being you. Love you.
